template.template_variables:
report_run_timestamp: !now
data_sources:
  agents:
    filter:
      site__client_id: '{{client.id}}'
    model: agent
    only:
    - hostname
    - operating_system
    - wmi_detail
    - total_ram
    - disks
    - agent_health
